detail.longDescription: is there a way to retain whitespaces when serializing an etree.Element with lxml? E.g.: <ph id="af7b8b15-8c62-4be5-a9dc-3c6e7a11b2ed" ctype="x-innovasys-property" innovasys:value="app_name" /> turns into: <ph id="af7b8b15-8c62-4be5-a9dc-3c6e7a11b2ed" ctype="x-innovasys-property" innovasys:value="app_name"/> which is not the desired behaviour. With xml.Etree this works (I guess because of this short_empty_elements=True ), but I have to use lxml.
